head: 31babe87a7ef1e40a0d4bedc523077e7a45d63ab
authority: Owner explicitly authorized F1/F2 test strengthening, retaining 65 original cases, compiling/RED/regressions and board evidence. No product function implementation authorized.

changes.F1: Existing save_only cases now assert literal complete missing-cause lists, not merely nonempty/sorted. Combined projection asserts approvalRefs + topology and preserves sorted/unique checks.
changes.F2: Three separate mixed invalid-structure + incomplete-decision tests assert existing typed structural errors first, with nonempty reason and input immutability.
changes.oracle_guards: Two new tests exercise only the test assertion helper. catch_unwind is limited to known assertion panics and must yield Err. These are not production exception handling or substitutes for behavioral RED.
changes.preserved: All original 65 behavior names, original 2 fixture guards and prior assertions retained. Original 65 remain RED; no ignored/deleted cases.

missing_cause_vocabulary.basis: Use existing M01 camel-case FieldPath vocabulary (topology, approvalRefs, deliveryTargets) and requirement-index/property paths for actual missing cause. No public model/error/function signature changed. open_decisions entries already carry FieldPath values and are deduplicated with completeness causes.
missing_cause_vocabulary.oracle: Literal per-case expectations; no target-policy call or duplicate generation algorithm is used to derive expected results.

results.RED_classification: All 68 failed public-boundary tests stop at the original missing-behavior marker; no compile/fixture/environment failure counted.

architecture_review: Same WORK pure-policy public boundary and M01 ownership. No new Port/adapter/schema/dependency/transaction/lifecycle semantics or business code. Only tests strengthened to the already approved order/reasons.
independent_reacceptance: NOT RUN; this correction is not self-approved acceptance

commands.name: regression
commands.command: cargo test -p sgenaxis-work --lib --test phase1_project_definition --test phase1_document_history --test project_manifest --test project_s1 --test run_binding_reservation --locked

next: Read-only reaccept F1/F2 changes, exact test scope and 68 intended RED. Product GREEN and S2-S4 remain outside authorization.
